guitar.modelsText: Gibson ES-355 / Les Paul / PRS / Hentor Sportscaster
guitar.evidence: Alex Lifeson's gear evolved a lot over Rush's career (Gibson ES-355 in early years, then Les Pauls, then signature PRS models); medium confidence is appropriate given the variety.

tone.target: bright crunchy Marshall rhythm with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright crunchy Marshall rhythm with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A classic Marshall-style rhythm tone using the UK 45 amp model, boosted by a Green OD for articulation, followed by Chorus for sheen, and finished with a tight cabinet simulation.

rig.name: Rush - Closer To The Heart - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm playing.
Provide articulate crunch and boost upper mids without heavy fuzz.
